facts.P1_fx_receipts: Yes, freely; but report foreign accounts over USD 10,000 (FBAR).
facts.P2_fcy_account: Rare: big banks offer few personal foreign-currency accounts; fintechs fill the gap.
facts.P3_local_gateways: Local gateways not researched yet; see the services listed above.
facts.L1_registration: Sole proprietors need no federal registration; state licences vary.
facts.L2_tax_id: Your SSN, or an EIN from the IRS for your business.
facts.L3_income_tax_foreign: Worldwide income taxed at 10–37%, plus 15.3% self-employment tax and state taxes.
facts.L4_vat_gst: No federal VAT; state sales taxes apply, often above $100,000 sales per state.
facts.L5_data_protection: No single federal law; California's CCPA covers only big or data-heavy businesses.
facts.L6_consumer_ecommerce: Ship within your stated time or 30 days, or offer a refund (FTC).
facts.L7_incentives: Deduct up to 20% of business income (QBI, section 199A).
facts.D1_id_document: Driver licence, state ID card or passport.

watch_out.text: Self-employment tax adds 15.3% on top of income tax.
Pay estimated tax quarterly (Form 1040-ES), not just once a year.
Nevada residents can't hold Wise balances.
